name: Ecwid
description: Ecwid is an ecommerce platform, branded "#1 Ecommerce Shopping Cart & Online Store," that lets merchants launch a store with no transaction fees and embed selling widgets into existing sites.
best_for: Positioned for businesses at any stage, from first-time sellers to scaling enterprises, with named verticals including dropshipping, wholesale, fashion, nonprofits, restaurants, and individual creators.
features: Embeddable shopping cart/widget for existing websites
Social selling (Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Pinterest, Snapchat, WhatsApp)
Automated tax calculation and shipping labels

alternatives.name: Shopify
alternatives.description: An all-in-one hosted commerce platform with its own storefront, checkout, and POS.
alternatives.best_for: Merchants wanting a dedicated, full-featured store rather than an embedded widget.

alternatives.name: PrestaShop
alternatives.description: An open-source self-hosted commerce platform giving merchants full platform ownership.
alternatives.best_for: Merchants wanting full platform ownership and customization.
